rules: Statements are what each party's leader or a senior spokesperson has said publicly about working with other parties after the election, quoted as reported by news media, with a link to the report.
We quote the part about who they will or won't work with. Reasons and descriptions of other parties are cut, marked '…'; the full quote is in the linked report.
Positions can change during the campaign, and not every party has been asked about every other party. The date shows when each statement was made or reported.

National.quote: we're open to working with them again post an election
We will not be working with Labour…
We're not going to be working with the Greens.
We won't be working with Te Pāti Māori…

Labour.on: On the Greens, after appearing together at Waitangi
Labour.quote: you can work constructively with people, still have disagreements…
Winston Peters has ruled us out. I'm happy to rule him out. It's clearly not going to happen.
Probably won't be Te Pāti Māori either…
But we haven't said that we're not willing to work with them.

Green.quote: We are not interested in reinstalling Christopher Luxon as Prime Minister
there are only two political parties asking for your party vote who are committed to changing the government

ACT.quote: we don't mind who we need to work with, notwithstanding there's a few that are non-starters.
very hard to know what you're getting with them

NZ First.quote: No, we won't do a deal with Labour or their … mates.

Te Pāti Māori.quote: We have begun serious and constructive conversations with the Labour Party and the Green Party
Our people on the streets and in the polls have told us they want a government led by our three parties at the helm.
Obviously there's some things that I could never agree with New Zealand First on … But on certain kaupapa, you have to work together

Opportunity.quote: The reality is that it's going to be either Labour or National... so we are going to have to find a way to work with them.
I think we have to get around the table and see how the votes fall

Te Tai Tokerau Party.on: On taking a call from the Prime Minister to help form a government
Te Tai Tokerau Party.quote: Imagine having Te Tai Tokerau at that table

Te Tai Tokerau Party.reported: 1News reported she "would not rule anyone out, suggesting she would let the people of Te Tai Tokerau guide her."
